scope: Preview three alternatives for the southwest cap only; production atlas and maps remain unchanged.

options.name: Warded pier
options.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE 32x32 RPG bridge end-cap sprite on actual transparent alpha. Reference image 1 shows the current southwest cap (left tile) and the ordinary south rail (right tile), enlarged. Reference image 2 shows its map context. Design a bolder, broader, distinctly ornamental replacement for ONLY that southwest cap. Output ONE standalone cap, not a bridge, not a two-tile strip and not a scene. The cap sits at the LEFT END of a horizontal stone rail which continues to its RIGHT. Its connector at the extreme right stays the same plain gray stone profile as the current cap; concentrate the ornamental mass in the left 28 pixels. Use almost the full 32x32 tile, taller and visually heavier than the thin ordinary rail, but keep a near-overhead orthographic camera at 75-80 degrees from horizontal with zero yaw; broad top face, very shallow south/front face, NO long pillar, no legs and no isometric slant. Bold readable chunky pixel-art forms, coarse 32px game sprite detail, muted warm gray granite, dark carved grooves, pale small snow patches, restrained light. Snow must not hide the ornament. Isolated whole object with minimal empty margins, square canvas. No ground plane, no backdrop, no characters, no text, no extra objects, no light glow, no gold, no gemstones, no cast shadow. Preserve a clear horizontal east-facing join. A single stout OCTAGONAL carved stone newel with a broad two-tier beveled cap and one large recessed diamond/ward symbol on its upper face. A massive clean geometric silhouette, broad chiseled edge bands, very small snow lip at the northwest edge. One bold central decorative mark readable at 32px.
